def: Strolling with no aim, just to take in the city.
ex: J'adore la flânerie le dimanche.
tr: I love an aimless stroll on Sundays.

ex: On a flâné le long de la Seine.
tr: We strolled along the Seine.

def: The feeling of being somewhere new and unfamiliar.
ex: Ce voyage nous a offert un vrai dépaysement.
tr: This trip gave us a real change of scene.

def: A reunion with someone after a long time.
ex: Les retrouvailles à la gare étaient émouvantes.
tr: The reunion at the station was moving.

def: Love at first sight (literally, a lightning strike).
ex: Pour eux, c'était le coup de foudre.
tr: For them, it was love at first sight.

ex: Elle déborde de joie de vivre.
tr: She's bursting with joie de vivre.

ex: Ils chuchotaient au fond de la classe.
tr: They were whispering at the back of the class.

ex: Les réverbères s'allument au crépuscule.
tr: The streetlamps come on at dusk.

ex: Nous sommes partis à l'aube.
tr: We left at dawn.

ex: Il était perdu dans sa rêverie.
tr: He was lost in his daydream.

ex: Un papillon s'est posé sur la fleur.
tr: A butterfly landed on the flower.

ex: Les lucioles brillent dans le jardin.
tr: Fireflies are glowing in the garden.

ex: Je prends un jus de pamplemousse.
tr: I'll have a grapefruit juice.

ex: Le spectacle a émerveillé les enfants.
tr: The show filled the children with wonder.

ex: La douceur du soir nous a surpris.
tr: The mildness of the evening surprised us.

ex: Le bonheur se trouve dans les petites choses.
tr: Happiness is found in the little things.

ex: Elle semble épanouie dans son travail.
tr: She seems happy and fulfilled in her work.

def: A love of good food; a sweet treat.
ex: Ce gâteau est une vraie gourmandise.
tr: This cake is a real treat.

ex: Les enfants prennent leur goûter à quatre heures.
tr: The children have their snack at four.

ex: Dimanche, je fais la grasse matinée.
tr: On Sunday I'm sleeping in.

ex: On fait du lèche-vitrines rue de Rivoli.
tr: We're window shopping on the Rue de Rivoli.

ex: La boulangerie ouvre à sept heures.
tr: The bakery opens at seven.

def: Daily life; also a daily newspaper.
ex: Le vélo fait partie de mon quotidien.
tr: Cycling is part of my daily life.

ex: Quelle pagaille dans ta chambre!
tr: What a mess your room is!

ex: Une eau pétillante, s'il vous plaît.
tr: A sparkling water, please.

ex: Dorénavant, je me lève tôt.
tr: From now on, I'm getting up early.

ex: D'ailleurs, il commence à pleuvoir.
tr: Besides, it's starting to rain.

ex: C'est cher, mais je le prends quand même.
tr: It's expensive, but I'll take it anyway.

ex: Bref, on est rentrés tard.
tr: Anyway, we got home late.

def: A kiss on the cheek; also a cold north wind.
ex: On se fait la bise pour se dire bonjour.
tr: We greet each other with a kiss on the cheek.

ex: Je me débrouille en français.
tr: I get by in French.

ex: On a bien rigolé hier soir.
tr: We had a good laugh last night.

def: A friend, a pal; also a boyfriend.
ex: Je sors avec des copains ce soir.
tr: I'm going out with friends tonight.

def: Great, nice (informal); as a noun, an owl.
ex: C'est chouette, ton appartement!
tr: Your apartment is great!

def: A thing, a whatsit; also a trick.
ex: Passe-moi le truc sur la table.
tr: Pass me the thing on the table.

ex: J'ai la flemme de cuisiner ce soir.
tr: I can't be bothered to cook tonight.

ex: Tu as lu ce bouquin?
tr: Have you read this book?

ex: Il y a une robe magnifique dans la vitrine.
tr: There's a gorgeous dress in the window.

ex: N'oublie pas ton parapluie!
tr: Don't forget your umbrella!

ex: On attend une éclaircie pour sortir.
tr: We're waiting for a sunny spell to go out.

ex: Paris est en pleine canicule.
tr: Paris is in the middle of a heatwave.

ex: Une légère brise souffle de la mer.
tr: A light breeze is blowing in from the sea.

ex: Le coucher de soleil sur la plage était superbe.
tr: The sunset over the beach was gorgeous.

ex: Le paysage change à chaque saison.
tr: The landscape changes with every season.

ex: Les falaises d'Étretat sont célèbres.
tr: The cliffs of Étretat are famous.

def: A lighthouse; also a car headlight.
ex: Le phare guide les bateaux la nuit.
tr: The lighthouse guides the boats at night.

ex: À marée basse, on peut marcher jusqu'à l'île.
tr: At low tide, you can walk to the island.

ex: Les enfants ramassent des coquillages.
tr: The children are collecting seashells.

ex: Les vagues sont énormes aujourd'hui.
tr: The waves are huge today.

ex: Le train part du quai numéro trois.
tr: The train leaves from platform three.

ex: Rendez-vous devant la gare à midi.
tr: Meet in front of the station at noon.

ex: J'ai acheté un billet aller-retour.
tr: I bought a round-trip ticket.

def: To stamp a ticket before boarding.
ex: N'oubliez pas de composter votre billet.
tr: Don't forget to stamp your ticket.

ex: J'ai raté ma correspondance à Lyon.
tr: I missed my connection in Lyon.

ex: Regarde le tableau des départs!
tr: Look at the departures board!

ex: Le train est en retard de dix minutes.
tr: The train is ten minutes late.

ex: L'horloge de la gare indique midi.
tr: The station clock says noon.

def: A notebook; also a book of tickets.
ex: J'écris tout dans mon carnet.
tr: I write everything in my notebook.

def: A feather; also a pen nib.
ex: Il écrit encore avec une plume.
tr: He still writes with a nib pen.

ex: J'ai écrit un brouillon de ma lettre.
tr: I wrote a rough draft of my letter.

ex: Le peintre a fait une esquisse au crayon.
tr: The painter made a pencil sketch.

ex: La Joconde est un chef-d'œuvre.
tr: The Mona Lisa is a masterpiece.

def: The opening night of an art show.
ex: On est invités au vernissage vendredi.
tr: We're invited to the opening on Friday.

def: A canvas, a painting; also the web.
ex: Cette toile date de 1890.
tr: This painting dates from 1890.

ex: Le soleil m'éblouit.
tr: The sun is dazzling me.

ex: La mer était étincelante ce matin.
tr: The sea was sparkling this morning.

def: A wink; a playful nod to something.
ex: Ce titre est un clin d'œil à Proust.
tr: This title is a nod to Proust.

def: To feel down (literally, to have the cockroach).
ex: J'ai le cafard quand il pleut.
tr: I feel down when it rains.

def: To stand someone up (literally, to put down a rabbit).
ex: Il m'a posé un lapin hier soir.
tr: He stood me up last night.

def: To feel great (literally, to have the peach).
ex: Ce matin, j'ai la pêche!
tr: I feel great this morning!

w: coûter les yeux de la tête
def: To cost an arm and a leg (literally, the eyes in your head).
ex: Ce sac coûte les yeux de la tête.
tr: This bag costs an arm and a leg.

def: To faint (literally, to fall into the apples).
ex: Il a failli tomber dans les pommes.
tr: He nearly fainted.

w: avoir un chat dans la gorge
def: To have a frog in your throat (literally, a cat).
ex: Pardon, j'ai un chat dans la gorge.
tr: Sorry, I have a frog in my throat.

ex: Prends ton parapluie, il pleut des cordes.
tr: Take your umbrella, it's pouring.

def: To put in your two cents (literally, your grain of salt).
ex: Il faut toujours qu'il mette son grain de sel.
tr: He always has to put in his two cents.

def: To have your head in the clouds (literally, to be in the moon).
ex: Désolé, j'étais dans la lune.
tr: Sorry, I was miles away.

def: To tell tall tales (literally, to tell salads).
ex: Arrête de raconter des salades!
tr: Stop telling tall tales!

def: To have bigger fish to fry (literally, other cats to whip).
ex: Désolé, j'ai d'autres chats à fouetter.
tr: Sorry, I have bigger fish to fry.

def: The icing on the cake (literally, the cherry).
ex: Et le soleil, c'était la cerise sur le gâteau.
tr: And the sunshine was the icing on the cake.

def: Thinking of the perfect reply too late (literally, staircase wit).
ex: J'ai trouvé la réponse ce soir: l'esprit de l'escalier!
tr: I thought of the answer tonight: too late!

ex: Il manque un peu de savoir-vivre.
tr: He's a bit lacking in manners.

ex: Elle parle aux élèves avec bienveillance.
tr: She speaks to the students with kindness.

ex: Il regarde sa fille avec tendresse.
tr: He looks at his daughter tenderly.

ex: Notre amitié dure depuis vingt ans.
tr: Our friendship has lasted twenty years.

ex: Viens, fais-moi un câlin.
tr: Come here, give me a hug.

ex: Cette chanson me remplit de nostalgie.
tr: This song fills me with nostalgia.

ex: J'ai de beaux souvenirs de cet été.
tr: I have lovely memories of that summer.

ex: Ce week-end, je me dorlote.
tr: This weekend, I'm pampering myself.

ex: J'aime grignoter des amandes.
tr: I like to nibble on almonds.

ex: Savourez chaque bouchée.
tr: Savor every bite.

def: A slice of bread with butter or jam.
ex: Une tartine et un café, s'il vous plaît.
tr: Bread and butter and a coffee, please.

def: A toasted ham and cheese sandwich.
ex: Je prends un croque-monsieur.
tr: I'll have a croque-monsieur.

ex: On achète nos légumes au marché.
tr: We buy our vegetables at the market.

def: The land and local character a food or wine comes from.
ex: Ce fromage a le goût du terroir.
tr: This cheese tastes of where it comes from.

ex: Trinquons à notre amitié!
tr: Let's drink to our friendship!

ex: Santé! À nous!
tr: Cheers! To us!

ex: On boit un verre en terrasse?
tr: Shall we have a drink outside?

def: An appointment, a date, a meeting.
ex: J'ai rendez-vous chez le dentiste.
tr: I have a dentist appointment.

ex: J'adore ce quartier.
tr: I love this neighborhood.

ex: On s'est perdus dans les ruelles du Marais.
tr: We got lost in the lanes of the Marais.

ex: Les réverbères s'allument un à un.
tr: The streetlamps come on one by one.

ex: Les pavés de Montmartre sont glissants.
tr: The cobblestones in Montmartre are slippery.

ex: Il a connu l'ivresse des sommets.
tr: He knew the thrill of the summits.

ex: Elle a passé l'examen avec sérénité.
tr: She took the exam calmly.

ex: Le village est très paisible.
tr: The village is very peaceful.

ex: Il reste une lueur d'espoir.
tr: There's still a glimmer of hope.

ex: Les étoiles scintillent.
tr: The stars are twinkling.

def: A sleepless night (literally, a white night).
ex: J'ai passé une nuit blanche à lire.
tr: I stayed up all night reading.

ex: Une petite sieste après le déjeuner?
tr: A little nap after lunch?

ex: On a bavardé pendant des heures.
tr: We chatted for hours.

ex: La veille du départ, on a fait les valises.
tr: The day before leaving, we packed.

ex: Le lendemain, il faisait beau.
tr: The next day, the weather was lovely.

def: In the past, once upon a time.
ex: Autrefois, ce café était une gare.
tr: This café used to be a station.

ex: Merci pour tout, et à bientôt!
tr: Thanks for everything, and see you soon!

def: The ends of the earth; somewhere very remote.
ex: Ce village, c'est le bout du monde.
tr: This village is the back of beyond.

ex: Une madeleine et un thé, comme chez Proust.
tr: A madeleine and tea, as in Proust.

ex: Ma valise est trop lourde!
tr: My suitcase is too heavy!

ex: Sans boussole, on s'est un peu perdus.
tr: Without a compass, we got a bit lost.

ex: Il rêvasse en regardant la pluie.
tr: He daydreams while watching the rain.

ex: On fait un pique-nique au parc?
tr: Shall we have a picnic in the park?
